units.text: INT. FAMILY HOUSEBOAT - GALLEY - EVENING
The houseboat rocks in a slow, patient rhythm against the canal wall.
A copper lamp swings from a hook.
Steam rises from a pot of lentils, fogging the small round window.
Dinner is set for four on a table too small for it.
HENRIKA DOLAN (60s, gray braid, forearms dusted with flour) ladles soup without looking up.
Across from her sits her son, PIETER DOLAN (35, pressed shirt, a man who has practiced a speech in a mirror).
Beside him, his wife ANNELIES (33, careful hands, folding and refolding a napkin).
At the end of the table, an empty chair.
A folded newspaper rests on its seat.
Eat while it's hot.
units.name: HENRIKA

units.text: Mama, we need to talk about the boat.
units.name: PIETER

units.text: We are talking. Over soup. It's the best way.
units.name: HENRIKA

units.text: Annelies lays her spoon down with exact quiet.
The buyer is serious, Henrika.
units.name: ANNELIES

units.text: There is always a buyer. Last year there was a buyer.
units.name: HENRIKA

units.text: Papa's been gone two years.
units.name: PIETER

units.text: Henrika's ladle stops.
A single drop of soup falls and spreads on the cloth.
I know how long.
units.name: HENRIKA

units.text: Then you know we can't keep paying for the mooring --
units.name: PIETER

units.text: I know what we pay.
units.name: HENRIKA

units.text: A knock at the hull.
The door opens.
A STRANGER (40s, rain-soaked coat, a canvas satchel) stands on the gangway, hat in hand.
Forgive me. I was told Anders Dolan lived here.
units.name: STRANGER

units.text: Nobody breathes.
Henrika sets the ladle down.
Who told you that?
units.name: HENRIKA

units.text: A man in Rotterdam. He said to bring this.
units.name: STRANGER

units.text: He sets a brass compass on the table.
Pieter stares at it.
Annelies covers her mouth.
Where did you get that?
units.name: HENRIKA

units.text: My name is Casimir Rooke. Your husband sailed with me, ma'am. Eleven years ago, off Terschelling.
units.name: STRANGER

units.text: Eleven years? He was home eleven years ago.
units.name: PIETER

units.text: Was he?
units.name: CASIMIR

units.text: Henrika walks to the window and presses her palm to the cold glass.
The lamp keeps swinging.
Sit down, Mr. Rooke. Annelies, a bowl.
units.name: HENRIKA

units.text: Mama, no. Not now.
units.name: PIETER

units.text: Pieter, hush.
units.name: HENRIKA

units.text: You don't even know who he is!
units.name: PIETER

units.text: He stands so fast his chair crashes backward.
The soup trembles in its pot.
Two years! Two years you let us believe he drowned clean!
units.name: PIETER

units.text: Sit down.
units.name: HENRIKA

units.text: I will not sit down in his house, with his stranger, eating his lentils!
units.name: PIETER

units.text: Annelies reaches for his sleeve.
He shakes her off.
Casimir sets the satchel on the floor and does not move, a man who has walked into a fire he cannot put out.
He asked me to tell you he was sorry.
units.name: CASIMIR

units.text: Henrika turns.
For a long moment, only the water speaks against the hull.
